items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the other band that I’ve had since ’91, with Vic Juris, Tony Marino, Jamey Haddad for 10 years, and Phil Markowitz for the first 6, 7 years

ctx.x: Is this the one with Jimmy Pugh?

Yes, and [Allen] Vizzzutti and [Tom] Brechtlein, Rick Laird. Gayle [Moran] played, and four strings, string quartet. Ron Moss was the manager. He played trombone. Pugh, Vizzutti, and I think maybe another horn. I forget. Or maybe just me. I was the main soloist. I did a world tour with him. It was two weeks rehearsal in L.A. Then we did everything. That was very intense for a variety of reasons: because of my relationship with Chick, to be around him musically and socially, and then, he got me back to New York,…
Because he came to New York when he was about 20.
